items.question: Trong câu "Every organization operates according to an extensive set of policies, laws, and industry standards.", từ "extensive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every organization operates according to an extensive set of policies, laws, and industry standards.", what does "extensive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: extensive /ɪkˈstensɪv/ (tính từ): rộng lớn, bao quát. "An extensive set of" = một tập hợp lớn, phong phú; hay gặp trong "extensive experience", "extensive testing".
items.explanationEn: extensive /ɪkˈstensɪv/ (adjective): large in amount or scope. "An extensive set of" means a large, wide-ranging collection; common in "extensive experience" and "extensive testing".

items.question: Trong câu "most business rules originate OUTSIDE the context of any specific software application.", từ "originate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "most business rules originate OUTSIDE the context of any specific software application.", what does "originate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to come from, to start in
to be put off until later
items.explanation: originate /əˈrɪdʒɪneɪt/ (động từ): bắt nguồn, phát sinh. "Originate outside/in/from" = bắt nguồn từ đâu; danh từ liên quan là "origin" (nguồn gốc).
items.explanationEn: originate /əˈrɪdʒɪneɪt/ (verb): to come from, to start in. "Originate outside/in/from" says where something comes from; the related noun is "origin".

items.question: Trong câu "But they often dictate that the system must contain functionality to comply with them", từ "dictate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But they often dictate that the system must contain functionality to comply with them", what does "dictate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to say words for someone to write
items.explanation: dictate /dɪkˈteɪt/ (động từ): quy định, bắt buộc. "Dictate that..." = đòi hỏi/quy định rằng; nghĩa khác của "dictate" là đọc cho người khác viết.
items.explanationEn: dictate /dɪkˈteɪt/ (verb): to require or determine. "Dictate that..." means to make something necessary; another sense is to speak words for someone to write down.

items.question: Trong câu "But they often dictate that the system must contain functionality to comply with them", từ "comply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But they often dictate that the system must contain functionality to comply with them", what does "comply" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to act according to a rule
items.explanation: comply /kəmˈplaɪ/ (động từ): tuân thủ, làm theo. Luôn đi với "with": "comply with a regulation"; danh từ là "compliance" (sự tuân thủ).
items.explanationEn: comply /kəmˈplaɪ/ (verb): to act according to a rule. It always takes "with": "comply with a regulation"; the noun is "compliance".

items.question: Trong câu "A desirable outcome or high-level objective of the organization; the justification for undertaking the project", từ "justification" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A desirable outcome or high-level objective of the organization; the justification for undertaking the project", what does "justification" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a good reason for doing something
items.explanation: justification /ˌdʒʌstɪfɪˈkeɪʃn/ (danh từ): lý do biện minh. "The justification for doing X" = lý do chính đáng để làm X; nghĩa khác trong soạn thảo là căn lề.
items.explanationEn: justification /ˌdʒʌstɪfɪˈkeɪʃn/ (noun): a good reason for doing something. "The justification for doing X" is the reason that makes X worthwhile; in word processing it also means text alignment.

items.question: Trong câu "Business rules influence business processes by establishing vocabulary, imposing restrictions, triggering actions, and governing how computations are carried out.", từ "impose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Business rules influence business processes by establishing vocabulary, imposing restrictions, triggering actions, and governing how computations are carried out.", what does "impose" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to force a rule or limit on
items.explanation: impose /ɪmˈpəʊz/ (động từ): áp đặt, đặt ra. "Impose restrictions/constraints on" = đặt ra hạn chế lên ai/cái gì; trái nghĩa là "lift restrictions".
items.explanationEn: impose /ɪmˈpəʊz/ (verb): to force a rule or limit on. "Impose restrictions/constraints on" means to set limits on something; the opposite is "lift restrictions".

items.question: Trong câu "Business rules influence business processes by establishing vocabulary, imposing restrictions, triggering actions, and governing how computations are carried out.", từ "govern" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Business rules influence business processes by establishing vocabulary, imposing restrictions, triggering actions, and governing how computations are carried out.", what does "govern" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: govern /ˈɡʌvn/ (động từ): chi phối, điều khiển. "Govern how X is done" = quy định cách X diễn ra; nghĩa gốc là cai trị (chính phủ = government).
items.explanationEn: govern /ˈɡʌvn/ (verb): to control how something happens. "Govern how X is done" means to control the way X happens; the original sense is to rule a country.

items.question: Trong câu "many companies lack a unified effort to document rules in a common repository accessible to the IT organization.", từ "repository" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "many companies lack a unified effort to document rules in a common repository accessible to the IT organization.", what does "repository" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a central place where things are stored
items.explanation: repository /rɪˈpɒzətri/ (danh từ): kho lưu trữ tập trung. "A common/central repository" = kho lưu trữ chung; dev còn gặp từ này trong "Git repository".
items.explanationEn: repository /rɪˈpɒzətri/ (noun): a central place where things are stored. "A common/central repository" is a shared store; developers also meet it in "Git repository".

items.question: Trong câu "which leads to different applications enforcing the same rule inconsistently, or overlooking it entirely.", từ "overlook" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "which leads to different applications enforcing the same rule inconsistently, or overlooking it entirely.", what does "overlook" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to have a view from above
items.explanation: overlook /ˌəʊvəˈlʊk/ (động từ): bỏ sót, không để ý. "Overlook a detail" = bỏ sót chi tiết; nghĩa khác: "a room overlooking the sea" = nhìn ra biển.
items.explanationEn: overlook /ˌəʊvəˈlʊk/ (verb): to fail to notice. "Overlook a detail" means to miss it; another sense is a place that overlooks (has a view over) something.

items.question: Trong câu "Tracing each rule into the code that implements it makes it easier to update systems when the rules change, and it facilitates code reuse across projects.", từ "facilitate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tracing each rule into the code that implements it makes it easier to update systems when the rules change, and it facilitates code reuse across projects.", what does "facilitate" (verb) mean?
options: tạo điều kiện, giúp dễ dàng
items.explanation: facilitate /fəˈsɪlɪteɪt/ (động từ): tạo điều kiện, giúp dễ dàng. "Facilitate reuse/communication" = giúp việc tái sử dụng/giao tiếp dễ hơn; "facilitator" là người điều phối họp.
items.explanationEn: facilitate /fəˈsɪlɪteɪt/ (verb): to make something easier. "Facilitate reuse/communication" means to make it easier; a "facilitator" is someone who runs a meeting smoothly.

items.question: Trong câu "A simple taxonomy of five types works for most situations: facts, constraints, action enablers, inferences, computations.", từ "taxonomy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A simple taxonomy of five types works for most situations: facts, constraints, action enablers, inferences, computations.", what does "taxonomy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: taxonomy /tækˈsɒnəmi/ (danh từ): hệ thống phân loại. "A taxonomy of X" = cách chia X thành các nhóm có hệ thống; đừng nhầm với "tax" (thuế).
items.explanationEn: taxonomy /tækˈsɒnəmi/ (noun): a system of classification. "A taxonomy of X" is a structured way of grouping X into categories; it has nothing to do with "tax".

items.question: Trong câu "Collecting irrelevant facts can bog down business analysis.", từ "bog down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Collecting irrelevant facts can bog down business analysis.", what does "bog down" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to slow down or hold back
items.explanation: bog down /bɒɡ daʊn/ (cụm từ): làm sa lầy, trì trệ. "Get bogged down in details" = sa lầy vào chi tiết; "bog" nghĩa đen là vũng lầy.
items.explanationEn: bog down /bɒɡ daʊn/ (phrase): to slow down or hold back. "Get bogged down in details" means to be stuck and unable to progress; a "bog" is literally a swamp.

items.question: Trong câu "A constraint is a statement that restricts the actions the system or its users are allowed to perform.", từ "restrict" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A constraint is a statement that restricts the actions the system or its users are allowed to perform.", what does "restrict" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: restrict /rɪˈstrɪkt/ (động từ): giới hạn, hạn chế. "Restrict access to" = hạn chế quyền truy cập vào; danh từ là "restriction".
items.explanationEn: restrict /rɪˈstrɪkt/ (verb): to limit. "Restrict access to" means to limit who can get in; the noun is "restriction".

items.question: Trong câu "Web applications may not contain HTML tags or attributes deprecated by the HTML 5 standard.", từ "deprecated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Web applications may not contain HTML tags or attributes deprecated by the HTML 5 standard.", what does "deprecated" (adjective) mean?
options: đã được mã hoá bảo mật
vừa mới được bổ sung thêm
bị lỗi cú pháp nghiêm trọng
items.explanation: deprecated /ˈdeprəkeɪtɪd/ (tính từ): không còn khuyến nghị dùng. Trong tài liệu kỹ thuật, "deprecated API" = API vẫn chạy nhưng sắp bị bỏ, không nên dùng nữa.
items.explanationEn: deprecated /ˈdeprəkeɪtɪd/ (adjective): discouraged and being phased out. In technical docs, a "deprecated API" still works but is being phased out and should not be used.

items.question: Trong câu "a concise way to document them is a roles and permissions matrix", từ "concise" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a concise way to document them is a roles and permissions matrix", what does "concise" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concise /kənˈsaɪs/ (tính từ): ngắn gọn, súc tích. "A concise way to document" = cách ghi lại gọn gàng; trái nghĩa với "wordy" (dài dòng).
items.explanationEn: concise /kənˈsaɪs/ (adjective): brief but complete. "A concise way to document" is a short, clear one; the opposite is "wordy".

items.question: Trong câu "A constraining business rule can convey implications for development even when it does not translate directly into functionality.", từ "implication" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A constraining business rule can convey implications for development even when it does not translate directly into functionality.", what does "implication" (noun) mean?
options: hệ quả, ảnh hưởng kéo theo
items.explanation: implication /ˌɪmplɪˈkeɪʃn/ (danh từ): hệ quả, ảnh hưởng kéo theo. "Implications for X" = những hệ quả đối với X; đừng nhầm với "implementation" (việc cài đặt).
items.explanationEn: implication /ˌɪmplɪˈkeɪʃn/ (noun): a likely effect or consequence. "Implications for X" are the consequences for X; do not confuse it with "implementation".

items.question: Trong câu "Whenever these are reflected in software requirements, indicate the pertinent rule as the rationale for each derived requirement.", từ "pertinent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Whenever these are reflected in software requirements, indicate the pertinent rule as the rationale for each derived requirement.", what does "pertinent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: pertinent /ˈpɜːtɪnənt/ (tính từ): liên quan, thích đáng. "The pertinent rule/information" = quy tắc/thông tin có liên quan trực tiếp; gần nghĩa với "relevant".
items.explanationEn: pertinent /ˈpɜːtɪnənt/ (adjective): relevant to the matter. "The pertinent rule/information" is the one directly relevant; a close synonym is "relevant".

items.question: Trong câu "Each user must have a privilege level.", từ "privilege" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each user must have a privilege level.", what does "privilege" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the amount a person is paid
a right to do certain things
items.explanation: privilege /ˈprɪvəlɪdʒ/ (danh từ): quyền hạn truy cập. "Privilege level" = cấp quyền; trong bảo mật có "principle of least privilege" (quyền tối thiểu).
items.explanationEn: privilege /ˈprɪvəlɪdʒ/ (noun): a right to do certain things. "Privilege level" is a user's tier of permissions; security uses the "principle of least privilege".

items.question: Trong câu "An action enabler is a rule that triggers some activity if specific conditions are true.", từ "trigger" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An action enabler is a rule that triggers some activity if specific conditions are true.", what does "trigger" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: trigger /ˈtrɪɡə(r)/ (động từ): kích hoạt, gây ra. "Trigger an action/event" = làm cho hành động bắt đầu; "a trigger" (danh từ) còn là cò súng.
items.explanationEn: trigger /ˈtrɪɡə(r)/ (verb): to cause something to start. "Trigger an action/event" means to make it start; as a noun "a trigger" is also the lever on a gun.

items.question: Trong câu "makes the application exhibit the correct behaviour when the system detects the triggering event.", từ "exhibit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "makes the application exhibit the correct behaviour when the system detects the triggering event.", what does "exhibit" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to show a quality or behaviour
items.explanation: exhibit /ɪɡˈzɪbɪt/ (động từ): thể hiện, biểu lộ ra. "Exhibit behaviour/symptoms" = thể hiện hành vi/triệu chứng; nghĩa khác là trưng bày tác phẩm.
items.explanationEn: exhibit /ɪɡˈzɪbɪt/ (verb): to show a quality or behaviour. "Exhibit behaviour/symptoms" means to show them; another sense is to display works in a gallery.

items.question: Trong câu "On the last day of a calendar quarter, generate the mandated OSHA and EPA reports on chemical handling and disposal for that quarter.", từ "mandate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On the last day of a calendar quarter, generate the mandated OSHA and EPA reports on chemical handling and disposal for that quarter.", what does "mandate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mandate /ˈmændeɪt/ (động từ): bắt buộc theo quy định. "Mandated reports" = báo cáo bắt buộc theo luật; tính từ "mandatory" = bắt buộc.
items.explanationEn: mandate /ˈmændeɪt/ (verb): to officially require. "Mandated reports" are required by law or authority; the adjective "mandatory" means compulsory.

items.question: Trong câu "If the expiration date for a chemical container has been reached, then notify the person who currently possesses that container.", từ "expiration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the expiration date for a chemical container has been reached, then notify the person who currently possesses that container.", what does "expiration" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the end of a valid period
items.explanation: expiration /ˌekspəˈreɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự hết hạn. "Expiration date" = ngày hết hạn; động từ "expire" = hết hạn (token, mật khẩu, hợp đồng).
items.explanationEn: expiration /ˌekspəˈreɪʃn/ (noun): the end of a valid period. "Expiration date" is when something stops being valid; the verb "expire" applies to tokens, passwords and contracts.

items.question: Trong câu "If the expiration date for a chemical container has been reached, then notify the person who currently possesses that container.", từ "possess" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the expiration date for a chemical container has been reached, then notify the person who currently possesses that container.", what does "possess" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: possess /pəˈzes/ (động từ): sở hữu, đang giữ. "Possess an item" = đang có/giữ món đồ; danh từ "possession" = sự sở hữu, tài sản.
items.explanationEn: possess /pəˈzes/ (verb): to have or hold. "Possess an item" means to have it in your hands or ownership; the noun is "possession".

items.question: Trong câu "Businesses often develop policies intended to enhance commercial success.", từ "enhance" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Businesses often develop policies intended to enhance commercial success.", what does "enhance" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: enhance /ɪnˈhɑːns/ (động từ): nâng cao, cải thiện. "Enhance performance/success" = làm tốt hơn; "enhancement request" = yêu cầu cải tiến tính năng.
items.explanationEn: enhance /ɪnˈhɑːns/ (verb): to improve or increase. "Enhance performance/success" means to make it better; an "enhancement request" asks to improve a feature.

items.question: Trong câu "Consider how an online bookstore uses action enablers to stimulate impulse purchases after a customer has asked to buy a specific product", từ "stimulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Consider how an online bookstore uses action enablers to stimulate impulse purchases after a customer has asked to buy a specific product", what does "stimulate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: stimulate /ˈstɪmjuleɪt/ (động từ): kích thích, thúc đẩy. "Stimulate demand/purchases" = thúc đẩy nhu cầu/mua hàng; đừng nhầm với "simulate" (mô phỏng).
items.explanationEn: stimulate /ˈstɪmjuleɪt/ (verb): to encourage more of something. "Stimulate demand/purchases" means to encourage them; do not confuse it with "simulate".

items.question: Trong câu "A customer redeemed frequent-flyer miles to buy a ticket for his wife.", từ "redeem" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A customer redeemed frequent-flyer miles to buy a ticket for his wife.", what does "redeem" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make up for a fault
items.explanation: redeem /rɪˈdiːm/ (động từ): đổi (điểm, phiếu) lấy quà. "Redeem miles/points/a voucher" = dùng điểm/phiếu để đổi lấy hàng; nghĩa khác là chuộc lỗi.
items.explanationEn: redeem /rɪˈdiːm/ (verb): to exchange points or vouchers. "Redeem miles/points/a voucher" means to exchange them for goods; another sense is to make up for a past fault.

items.question: Trong câu "The rule is probably there for fraud prevention.", từ "fraud" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The rule is probably there for fraud prevention.", what does "fraud" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: fraud /frɔːd/ (danh từ): gian lận, lừa đảo. "Fraud prevention/detection" = phòng chống/phát hiện gian lận; rất hay gặp ở hệ thống thanh toán.
items.explanationEn: fraud /frɔːd/ (noun): deception for gain. "Fraud prevention/detection" is common in payment and banking systems.

items.question: Trong câu "the software implemented it in a way that produced usability shortcomings and customer inconvenience", từ "shortcoming" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the software implemented it in a way that produced usability shortcomings and customer inconvenience", what does "shortcoming" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: shortcoming /ˈʃɔːtkʌmɪŋ/ (danh từ): khiếm khuyết, thiếu sót. Thường dùng số nhiều: "usability shortcomings" = những điểm yếu về tính dễ dùng.
items.explanationEn: shortcoming /ˈʃɔːtkʌmɪŋ/ (noun): a flaw or weakness. Usually plural: "usability shortcomings" are weaknesses in how easy something is to use.

items.question: Trong câu "Poorly thought-out business rule implementations can adversely affect your customer and hence your business.", từ "adversely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Poorly thought-out business rule implementations can adversely affect your customer and hence your business.", what does "adversely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: adversely /ˈædvɜːsli/ (trạng từ): theo hướng bất lợi. "Adversely affect" = ảnh hưởng xấu; cụm cố định rất phổ biến trong văn bản chuyên môn.
items.explanationEn: adversely /ˈædvɜːsli/ (adverb): in a harmful way. "Adversely affect" means to harm; it is a very common fixed pair in formal writing.

items.question: Trong câu "Poorly thought-out business rule implementations can adversely affect your customer and hence your business.", từ "hence" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Poorly thought-out business rule implementations can adversely affect your customer and hence your business.", what does "hence" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: hence /hens/ (trạng từ): do đó, vì vậy. "Hence" = vì thế; trang trọng hơn "so", hay đứng trước danh từ hoặc mệnh đề kết quả.
items.explanationEn: hence /hens/ (adverb): as a result, therefore. "Hence" means therefore; it is more formal than "so" and often precedes the result.

items.question: Trong câu "An inference — sometimes called inferred knowledge or a derived fact — creates a new fact from other facts.", từ "infer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An inference — sometimes called inferred knowledge or a derived fact — creates a new fact from other facts.", what does "infer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: infer /ɪnˈfɜː(r)/ (động từ): suy ra, suy luận. "Infer X from Y" = suy ra X từ Y; danh từ "inference" = sự suy luận (cũng dùng trong AI).
items.explanationEn: infer /ɪnˈfɜː(r)/ (verb): to conclude from evidence. "Infer X from Y" means to reach X by reasoning from Y; the noun "inference" is also used in AI.

items.question: Trong câu "If a payment is not received within 30 calendar days after it is due, then the account is delinquent.", từ "delinquent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If a payment is not received within 30 calendar days after it is due, then the account is delinquent.", what does "delinquent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: delinquent /dɪˈlɪŋkwənt/ (tính từ): quá hạn thanh toán. "A delinquent account" = tài khoản nợ quá hạn; "juvenile delinquent" lại là trẻ vị thành niên phạm pháp.
items.explanationEn: delinquent /dɪˈlɪŋkwənt/ (adjective): overdue on payment. "A delinquent account" has overdue payments; a "juvenile delinquent" is a young offender.

items.question: Trong câu "If a payment is not received within 30 calendar days after it is due, then the account is delinquent.", từ "due" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If a payment is not received within 30 calendar days after it is due, then the account is delinquent.", what does "due" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: required to be paid by then
items.explanation: due /djuː/ (tính từ): đến hạn phải trả. "Be due" = đến hạn; "due date" = hạn chót; "with due care" lại mang nghĩa thích đáng.
items.explanationEn: due /djuː/ (adjective): required to be paid by then. "Be due" means payable or expected now; "due date" is the deadline, while "with due care" means appropriate care.

items.question: Trong câu "Many computations follow rules that are external to the enterprise, such as income tax withholding formulas.", từ "withholding" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many computations follow rules that are external to the enterprise, such as income tax withholding formulas.", what does "withholding" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: withholding /wɪðˈhəʊldɪŋ/ (danh từ): khấu trừ giữ lại (thuế). "Tax withholding" = khấu trừ thuế tại nguồn; động từ "withhold" = giữ lại, không đưa ra.
items.explanationEn: withholding /wɪðˈhəʊldɪŋ/ (noun): deducting tax before payment. "Tax withholding" is tax taken from pay at source; the verb "withhold" means to hold back.

items.question: Trong câu "writing computation details in natural language is often wordy and confusing.", từ "wordy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "writing computation details in natural language is often wordy and confusing.", what does "wordy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: wordy /ˈwɜːdi/ (tính từ): dài dòng, nhiều chữ. "Wordy and confusing" = dài dòng và khó hiểu; trái nghĩa là "concise".
items.explanationEn: wordy /ˈwɜːdi/ (adjective): using too many words. "Wordy and confusing" means long-winded and unclear; the opposite is "concise".

items.question: Trong câu "Watch out for overlapping ranges when writing a set of rules or requirements that define ranges.", từ "overlap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Watch out for overlapping ranges when writing a set of rules or requirements that define ranges.", what does "overlap" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to partly cover the same area
items.explanation: overlap /ˌəʊvəˈlæp/ (động từ): chồng lấn lên nhau. "Overlapping ranges" = các khoảng giá trị chồng lên nhau, gây mơ hồ ở giá trị biên.
items.explanationEn: overlap /ˌəʊvəˈlæp/ (verb): to partly cover the same area. "Overlapping ranges" share some values, which creates ambiguity at the boundaries.

items.question: Trong câu "It is easy to inadvertently define ranges like 1–5, 5–10, 10–20, which introduces ambiguity about which range the values of exactly 5 and exactly 10 fall into.", từ "inadvertently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is easy to inadvertently define ranges like 1–5, 5–10, 10–20, which introduces ambiguity about which range the values of exactly 5 and exactly 10 fall into.", what does "inadvertently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: inadvertently /ˌɪnədˈvɜːtəntli/ (trạng từ): vô tình, không cố ý. "Inadvertently" = vô ý; đồng nghĩa "accidentally", trái nghĩa "deliberately".
items.explanationEn: inadvertently /ˌɪnədˈvɜːtəntli/ (adverb): without meaning to. "Inadvertently" means by accident; synonyms are "accidentally" and "unintentionally".

items.question: Trong câu "It is easy to inadvertently define ranges like 1–5, 5–10, 10–20, which introduces ambiguity about which range the values of exactly 5 and exactly 10 fall into.", từ "ambiguity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is easy to inadvertently define ranges like 1–5, 5–10, 10–20, which introduces ambiguity about which range the values of exactly 5 and exactly 10 fall into.", what does "ambiguity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ambiguity /ˌæmbɪˈɡjuːəti/ (danh từ): sự mơ hồ, đa nghĩa. "Introduce ambiguity" = gây ra sự mơ hồ; yêu cầu tốt phải "unambiguous" (không mơ hồ).
items.explanationEn: ambiguity /ˌæmbɪˈɡjuːəti/ (noun): unclear, multiple meanings. "Introduce ambiguity" means to create doubt about meaning; good requirements must be "unambiguous".

items.question: Trong câu "Breaking the composite library rule into atomic rules", từ "composite" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Breaking the composite library rule into atomic rules", what does "composite" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: composite /ˈkɒmpəzɪt/ (tính từ): gồm nhiều phần ghép lại. "A composite rule" = quy tắc gộp nhiều ý; trái nghĩa trong bài là "atomic rule".
items.explanationEn: composite /ˈkɒmpəzɪt/ (adjective): made of several parts. "A composite rule" bundles several details; its opposite in the article is an "atomic rule".

items.question: Trong câu "it becomes time-consuming to find and modify the right code when just one part of the rule changes.", từ "time-consuming" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "it becomes time-consuming to find and modify the right code when just one part of the rule changes.", what does "time-consuming" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: time-consuming /ˈtaɪm kənsjuːmɪŋ/ (tính từ): tốn nhiều thời gian. "A time-consuming task" = việc mất nhiều thời gian; gần nghĩa "labour-intensive".
items.explanationEn: time-consuming /ˈtaɪm kənsjuːmɪŋ/ (adjective): taking a lot of time. "A time-consuming task" takes a long time; a close synonym is "labour-intensive".

items.question: Trong câu "If several functionality segments trace back to this complex rule", từ "segment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If several functionality segments trace back to this complex rule", what does "segment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: segment /ˈseɡmənt/ (danh từ): phần, đoạn. "Functionality segments" = các phần chức năng; trong marketing, "segment" là phân khúc thị trường.
items.explanationEn: segment /ˈseɡmənt/ (noun): a part or section. "Functionality segments" are parts of the functionality; in marketing a "segment" is a customer group.

items.question: Trong câu "These are called atomic because they cannot be decomposed further.", từ "decompose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These are called atomic because they cannot be decomposed further.", what does "decompose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: decompose /ˌdiːkəmˈpəʊz/ (động từ): phân rã, chia nhỏ. "Decompose a problem" = chia bài toán thành phần nhỏ; nghĩa sinh học là phân huỷ.
items.explanationEn: decompose /ˌdiːkəmˈpəʊz/ (verb): to break into smaller parts. "Decompose a problem" means to split it into smaller parts; in biology it means to rot.

items.question: Trong câu "when the next generation of video technology arrives, or the library purges all its DVDs", từ "purge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "when the next generation of video technology arrives, or the library purges all its DVDs", what does "purge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: purge /pɜːdʒ/ (động từ): loại bỏ sạch, thanh lọc. "Purge old records/cache" = xoá sạch dữ liệu cũ; hay gặp trong quản trị dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: purge /pɜːdʒ/ (verb): to get rid of completely. "Purge old records/cache" means to remove all of it; common in data administration.

items.question: Trong câu "A simple business rules catalog suffices to begin.", từ "suffice" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A simple business rules catalog suffices to begin.", what does "suffice" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: suffice /səˈfaɪs/ (động từ): đủ, đáp ứng được. "X suffices" = X là đủ; tính từ "sufficient" = đầy đủ.
items.explanationEn: suffice /səˈfaɪs/ (verb): to be enough. "X suffices" means X is enough; the adjective is "sufficient".

items.question: Trong câu "Large organizations, or those whose operations and information systems are heavily rule-driven, should establish a business rules database.", từ "establish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Large organizations, or those whose operations and information systems are heavily rule-driven, should establish a business rules database.", what does "establish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: establish /ɪˈstæblɪʃ/ (động từ): thiết lập, xây dựng. "Establish a database/process" = lập ra; nghĩa khác: "establish that..." = chứng minh rằng.
items.explanationEn: establish /ɪˈstæblɪʃ/ (verb): to set up or create. "Establish a database/process" means to set it up; "establish that..." means to prove that.

items.question: Trong câu "you can store business rules as a requirement type — provided they are accessible to all your projects.", từ "provided" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "you can store business rules as a requirement type — provided they are accessible to all your projects.", what does "provided" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: provided /prəˈvaɪdɪd/ (liên từ): với điều kiện là. "Provided (that)..." = miễn là, với điều kiện; đồng nghĩa "as long as".
items.explanationEn: provided /prəˈvaɪdɪd/ (conjunction): on condition that. "Provided (that)..." introduces a condition; a synonym is "as long as".

items.question: Trong câu "Commercial rule-management tools become valuable when your catalog outgrows a word processor, spreadsheet, wiki, or collaboration tool.", từ "outgrow" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Commercial rule-management tools become valuable when your catalog outgrows a word processor, spreadsheet, wiki, or collaboration tool.", what does "outgrow" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: outgrow /ˌaʊtˈɡrəʊ/ (động từ): vượt quá sức chứa. "Outgrow a tool" = phát triển lớn đến mức công cụ không còn phù hợp (như trẻ lớn không vừa quần áo).
items.explanationEn: outgrow /ˌaʊtˈɡrəʊ/ (verb): to become too large for. "Outgrow a tool" means to grow too big for it, like a child outgrowing clothes.

items.question: Trong câu "rather than embedding them in the documentation for that specific application or, worse, only in its code.", từ "embed" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "rather than embedding them in the documentation for that specific application or, worse, only in its code.", what does "embed" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: embed /ɪmˈbed/ (động từ): nhúng, gắn chặt vào. "Embed rules in code" = nhúng quy tắc vào mã, khó tìm và sửa; cũng dùng cho "embedded video".
items.explanationEn: embed /ɪmˈbed/ (verb): to fix firmly inside. "Embed rules in code" means to bury them inside it; the word is also used for "embedded video".

items.question: Trong câu "Rules related to safety, security, finance, or regulatory compliance pose the greatest risk if they are not managed and enforced appropriately.", từ "pose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rules related to safety, security, finance, or regulatory compliance pose the greatest risk if they are not managed and enforced appropriately.", what does "pose" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to present a risk or problem
items.explanation: pose /pəʊz/ (động từ): gây ra, đặt ra (rủi ro). "Pose a risk/threat/challenge" = gây ra rủi ro/mối đe doạ/thách thức; nghĩa khác là tạo dáng.
items.explanationEn: pose /pəʊz/ (verb): to present a risk or problem. "Pose a risk/threat/challenge" means to create it; another sense is to hold a position for a photo.

items.question: Trong câu "Rules related to safety, security, finance, or regulatory compliance pose the greatest risk if they are not managed and enforced appropriately.", từ "enforce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rules related to safety, security, finance, or regulatory compliance pose the greatest risk if they are not managed and enforced appropriately.", what does "enforce" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make sure a rule is obeyed
items.explanation: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːs/ (động từ): thực thi, bắt tuân theo. "Enforce a rule/policy" = đảm bảo quy tắc được tuân thủ; "law enforcement" = cơ quan thực thi pháp luật.
items.explanationEn: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːs/ (verb): to make sure a rule is obeyed. "Enforce a rule/policy" means to make people follow it; "law enforcement" is the police.

items.question: Trong câu "If they know that certain rules are subject to periodic change, they can structure the software to make the affected functionality or data easy to update.", từ "periodic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If they know that certain rules are subject to periodic change, they can structure the software to make the affected functionality or data easy to update.", what does "periodic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: periodic /ˌpɪəriˈɒdɪk/ (tính từ): định kỳ, theo chu kỳ. "Periodic change/review" = thay đổi/rà soát định kỳ; "periodically" = theo định kỳ.
items.explanationEn: periodic /ˌpɪəriˈɒdɪk/ (adjective): happening at regular intervals. "Periodic change/review" happens at intervals; the adverb is "periodically".

items.question: Trong câu "If they know that certain rules are subject to periodic change, they can structure the software to make the affected functionality or data easy to update.", từ "subject to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If they know that certain rules are subject to periodic change, they can structure the software to make the affected functionality or data easy to update.", what does "subject to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: subject to /ˈsʌbdʒɪkt tə/ (cụm từ): dễ bị, phải chịu. "Subject to change/approval" = có thể thay đổi/cần phê duyệt; rất hay gặp trong hợp đồng, tài liệu.
items.explanationEn: subject to /ˈsʌbdʒɪkt tə/ (phrase): likely to be affected by. "Subject to change/approval" means it may change or needs approval; common in contracts and docs.

items.question: Trong câu "it is far easier to update those values than if they were hard-coded into the software.", từ "hard-code" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "it is far easier to update those values than if they were hard-coded into the software.", what does "hard-code" (verb) mean?
options: viết cứng giá trị vào mã
optionsEn: to fix values directly in code
items.explanation: hard-code /ˌhɑːd ˈkəʊd/ (động từ): viết cứng giá trị vào mã. "Hard-coded values" = giá trị gắn chết trong mã; nên đưa vào bảng cấu hình hoặc database.
items.explanationEn: hard-code /ˌhɑːd ˈkəʊd/ (verb): to fix values directly in code. "Hard-coded values" are fixed in source code; volatile values belong in config tables or a database.

items.question: Trong câu "Laws of humans are much more volatile.", từ "volatile" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Laws of humans are much more volatile.", what does "volatile" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: volatile /ˈvɒlətaɪl/ (tính từ): dễ thay đổi, bất ổn. "Volatile rules/prices" = dễ biến động; trong máy tính, "volatile memory" là bộ nhớ mất khi tắt nguồn.
items.explanationEn: volatile /ˈvɒlətaɪl/ (adjective): likely to change quickly. "Volatile rules/prices" change often; in computing "volatile memory" loses data without power.

items.question: Trong câu "patterns of keywords and clauses that structure rules consistently", từ "clause" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "patterns of keywords and clauses that structure rules consistently", what does "clause" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a group of words with a verb
items.explanation: clause /klɔːz/ (danh từ): mệnh đề (ngữ pháp). "If clause / then clause" = mệnh đề nếu/thì; trong pháp lý "clause" là điều khoản.
items.explanationEn: clause /klɔːz/ (noun): a group of words with a verb. "If clause / then clause" are parts of a sentence; in law a "clause" is a section of a contract.

items.question: Trong câu "does not help much when eliciting user requirements", từ "elicit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "does not help much when eliciting user requirements", what does "elicit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: elicit /iˈlɪsɪt/ (động từ): khơi gợi, thu thập. "Elicit requirements" = khai thác yêu cầu từ người dùng; đừng nhầm với "illicit" (bất hợp pháp).
items.explanationEn: elicit /iˈlɪsɪt/ (verb): to draw out information. "Elicit requirements" means to draw them out of stakeholders; do not confuse it with "illicit".

items.question: Trong câu "Legacy systems — where business rules are embedded in requirements and code.", từ "legacy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Legacy systems — where business rules are embedded in requirements and code.", what does "legacy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: legacy /ˈleɡəsi/ (tính từ): cũ, kế thừa từ trước. "Legacy system/code" = hệ thống/mã cũ còn đang dùng; danh từ "legacy" còn là di sản.
items.explanationEn: legacy /ˈleɡəsi/ (adjective): old but still in use. "Legacy system/code" is old technology still in use; as a noun "legacy" also means inheritance.

items.question: Trong câu "This requires reverse-engineering the rationale behind the requirements or code.", từ "rationale" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This requires reverse-engineering the rationale behind the requirements or code.", what does "rationale" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rationale /ˌræʃəˈnɑːl/ (danh từ): lý do cơ sở. "The rationale behind X" = lý lẽ giải thích vì sao có X; phát âm khác "rational" (hợp lý).
items.explanationEn: rationale /ˌræʃəˈnɑːl/ (noun): the reasons behind a decision. "The rationale behind X" explains why X exists; note it is pronounced differently from "rational".

items.question: Trong câu "This sometimes yields incomplete knowledge.", từ "yield" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This sometimes yields incomplete knowledge.", what does "yield" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: yield /jiːld/ (động từ): mang lại, tạo ra. "Yield results/knowledge" = mang lại kết quả; nghĩa khác "yield to" = nhường, chịu thua.
items.explanationEn: yield /jiːld/ (verb): to produce a result. "Yield results/knowledge" means to produce them; "yield to" means to give way or surrender.

items.question: Trong câu "Computational formulas implemented in the code of legacy applications may be obsolete.", từ "obsolete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Computational formulas implemented in the code of legacy applications may be obsolete.", what does "obsolete" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: out of date, no longer used
items.explanation: obsolete /ˈɒbsəliːt/ (tính từ): lỗi thời, không còn dùng. "Obsolete formulas/technology" = công thức/công nghệ đã lỗi thời; gần nghĩa "outdated".
items.explanationEn: obsolete /ˈɒbsəliːt/ (adjective): out of date, no longer used. "Obsolete formulas/technology" are no longer valid; a close synonym is "outdated".

items.question: Trong câu "Be sure to confirm whether rules gleaned from older documents and applications need updating.", từ "glean" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Be sure to confirm whether rules gleaned from older documents and applications need updating.", what does "glean" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: glean /ɡliːn/ (động từ): góp nhặt, thu lượm. "Glean information from" = thu lượm thông tin dần dần từ nhiều nguồn.
items.explanationEn: glean /ɡliːn/ (verb): to gather bit by bit. "Glean information from" means to collect it gradually, often from scattered sources.

items.question: Trong câu "Also assess the scope of applicability of the rules you discover", từ "applicability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Also assess the scope of applicability of the rules you discover", what does "applicability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: applicability /əˌplɪkəˈbɪləti/ (danh từ): khả năng áp dụng. "Scope of applicability" = phạm vi áp dụng; tính từ "applicable" = có thể áp dụng.
items.explanationEn: applicability /əˌplɪkəˈbɪləti/ (noun): how widely something applies. "Scope of applicability" is how widely something applies; the adjective is "applicable".

items.question: Trong câu "or do they span a business domain or the entire enterprise?", từ "span" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "or do they span a business domain or the entire enterprise?", what does "span" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: span /spæn/ (động từ): trải rộng, bao trùm. "Span multiple teams/years" = trải dài qua nhiều nhóm/năm; danh từ "time span" = khoảng thời gian.
items.explanationEn: span /spæn/ (verb): to extend across. "Span multiple teams/years" means to extend across them; "time span" is a period of time.

items.question: Trong câu "ask questions probing the rationale behind the requirements and constraints users present", từ "probe" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "ask questions probing the rationale behind the requirements and constraints users present", what does "probe" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: probe /prəʊb/ (động từ): thăm dò, tìm hiểu sâu. "Probing questions" = câu hỏi đào sâu; trong kỹ thuật "probe" còn là đầu dò/kiểm tra sức khoẻ dịch vụ.
items.explanationEn: probe /prəʊb/ (verb): to explore in depth. "Probing questions" dig deeper; in engineering a "probe" is also a sensor or a health check.

items.question: Trong câu "these discussions frequently surface business rules as the underlying reason.", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "these discussions frequently surface business rules as the underlying reason.", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɜːfɪs/ (động từ): làm lộ ra, đưa ra. "Surface an issue" = làm vấn đề lộ ra; danh từ "surface" là bề mặt.
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɜːfɪs/ (verb): to bring to attention. "Surface an issue" means to bring it into view; as a noun "surface" is the outside layer.

items.question: Trong câu "which rules pertain to their application", từ "pertain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "which rules pertain to their application", what does "pertain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: pertain /pəˈteɪn/ (động từ): liên quan đến, thuộc về. "Pertain to" = liên quan đến; cùng họ với tính từ "pertinent".
items.explanationEn: pertain /pəˈteɪn/ (verb): to relate or apply to. "Pertain to" means to relate to; it shares a root with the adjective "pertinent".

items.question: Trong câu "The analyst would derive different functional requirements depending on the environment", từ "derive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The analyst would derive different functional requirements depending on the environment", what does "derive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (động từ): suy ra, rút ra. "Derive X from Y" = rút ra X từ Y; "derived requirement" = yêu cầu được suy ra từ quy tắc.
items.explanationEn: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (verb): to obtain from a source. "Derive X from Y" means to get X from Y; a "derived requirement" comes from a rule.

items.question: Trong câu "an opened can of ether becomes unsafe because it can form explosive byproducts in the presence of oxygen.", từ "byproduct" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "an opened can of ether becomes unsafe because it can form explosive byproducts in the presence of oxygen.", what does "byproduct" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the main output of a process
a raw material for a process
a secondary result of a process
items.explanation: byproduct /ˈbaɪprɒdʌkt/ (danh từ): sản phẩm phụ. "A byproduct of X" = thứ phát sinh thêm khi làm X; nghĩa bóng là tác dụng phụ.
items.explanationEn: byproduct /ˈbaɪprɒdʌkt/ (noun): a secondary result of a process. "A byproduct of X" is something extra produced along the way; figuratively, a side effect.

items.question: Trong câu "the table only shows the suffixes to append to the parent requirement label.", từ "append" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the table only shows the suffixes to append to the parent requirement label.", what does "append" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: append /əˈpend/ (động từ): nối thêm vào cuối. "Append X to Y" = nối X vào cuối Y; dev gặp trong "append to a list/file".
items.explanationEn: append /əˈpend/ (verb): to add at the end. "Append X to Y" means to add X to the end of Y; developers use it for lists and files.

items.question: Trong câu "To prevent redundancy, do not duplicate rules from your catalog in the requirements documentation.", từ "redundancy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To prevent redundancy, do not duplicate rules from your catalog in the requirements documentation.", what does "redundancy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: redundancy /rɪˈdʌndənsi/ (danh từ): sự trùng lặp dư thừa. Ở đây là trùng lặp thông tin; trong hạ tầng "redundancy" là dự phòng, còn ở Anh là bị cho thôi việc.
items.explanationEn: redundancy /rɪˈdʌndənsi/ (noun): unnecessary repetition. Here it means needless duplication; in infrastructure it means backup capacity, and in the UK losing a job.

items.question: Trong câu "Be aware that hyperlinks are prone to breaking if the location of the rules collection changes.", từ "prone to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Be aware that hyperlinks are prone to breaking if the location of the rules collection changes.", what does "prone to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: prone to /prəʊn tə/ (cụm từ): dễ bị, có xu hướng. "Prone to errors/breaking" = dễ bị lỗi/hỏng; từ ghép "error-prone" = dễ sinh lỗi.
items.explanationEn: prone to /prəʊn tə/ (phrase): likely to suffer from. "Prone to errors/breaking" means likely to fail; the compound "error-prone" is common.

items.question: Trong câu "because rules are not buried in the documentation for any single application.", từ "bury" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "because rules are not buried in the documentation for any single application.", what does "bury" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put a body in a grave
items.explanation: bury /ˈberi/ (động từ): vùi lấp, giấu kín. "Buried in the documentation" = bị lẫn sâu trong tài liệu, khó tìm; nghĩa gốc là chôn.
items.explanationEn: bury /ˈberi/ (verb): to hide deep inside. "Buried in the documentation" means hard to find inside it; the literal sense is to put in the ground.

items.question: Trong câu "because they simply point to the master instance.", từ "instance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "because they simply point to the master instance.", what does "instance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: instance /ˈɪnstəns/ (danh từ): bản thể, bản gốc. "The master instance" = bản chính duy nhất; "for instance" lại nghĩa là ví dụ.
items.explanationEn: instance /ˈɪnstəns/ (noun): a single occurrence or copy. "The master instance" is the one authoritative copy; "for instance" means for example.

items.question: Trong câu "Distinguish three kinds of constraint", từ "distinguish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Distinguish three kinds of constraint", what does "distinguish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: distinguish /dɪˈstɪŋɡwɪʃ/ (động từ): phân biệt. "Distinguish A from B" = phân biệt A với B; đừng nhầm với "extinguish" (dập tắt).
items.explanationEn: distinguish /dɪˈstɪŋɡwɪʃ/ (verb): to tell apart. "Distinguish A from B" means to tell them apart; do not confuse it with "extinguish".

items.question: Trong câu "remind you of rules you would otherwise miss", từ "otherwise" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "remind you of rules you would otherwise miss", what does "otherwise" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: otherwise /ˈʌðəwaɪz/ (trạng từ): nếu không thì. "Would otherwise miss" = nếu không có cái này thì sẽ bỏ lỡ.
items.explanationEn: otherwise /ˈʌðəwaɪz/ (adverb): if not for this. "Would otherwise miss" means would miss if it were not for this.

items.question: Trong câu "Record the type, volatility, and source of each rule — three pieces of information that directly help developers and maintainers.", từ "volatility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Record the type, volatility, and source of each rule — three pieces of information that directly help developers and maintainers.", what does "volatility" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: how likely it is to change
items.explanation: volatility /ˌvɒləˈtɪləti/ (danh từ): mức độ dễ thay đổi. Danh từ của "volatile"; "price volatility" = biến động giá.
items.explanationEn: volatility /ˌvɒləˈtɪləti/ (noun): how likely it is to change. The noun form of "volatile"; "price volatility" is how much prices swing.

items.question: Trong câu "Remember that a thoughtless implementation of a perfectly sensible rule can still ruin the customer experience.", từ "thoughtless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Remember that a thoughtless implementation of a perfectly sensible rule can still ruin the customer experience.", what does "thoughtless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: thoughtless /ˈθɔːtləs/ (tính từ): thiếu suy nghĩ, cẩu thả. "A thoughtless implementation" = cách làm thiếu cân nhắc; trái nghĩa "thoughtful".
items.explanationEn: thoughtless /ˈθɔːtləs/ (adjective): done without care. "A thoughtless implementation" ignores the consequences; the opposite is "thoughtful".

items.question: Trong câu "so everything stays in step as rules change.", từ "in step" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "so everything stays in step as rules change.", what does "in step" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in step /ɪn step/ (cụm từ): đồng bộ, khớp nhau. "Stay in step with" = luôn khớp/đồng bộ với; trái nghĩa "out of step".
items.explanationEn: in step /ɪn step/ (phrase): in agreement, in sync. "Stay in step with" means to remain in sync; the opposite is "out of step".
